deployment.purpose: certify the namespace-scoped workload before enabling the draft catalog item

minio_client_image.red: The declared MinIO client tag did not exist.
minio_client_image.green: The pinned RELEASE.2023-06-19T19-31-19Z image completed bucket bootstrap.

ui_resource_behavior.red: NGINX inherited the host CPU count, spawned 172 workers, and was OOMKilled at 128 MiB.
ui_resource_behavior.green: A generated NGINX config limits the UI to one worker; the UI remained Ready.

database_roles.red: Migrations and LangGraph checkpoint initialization failed because runtime roles were absent and lending_app could not create checkpoint tables.
database_roles.green: Bootstrap creates separate generated-password roles, migrations use the admin URL, and lending_app has only the database and public-schema permissions needed by the application.

api_startup.red: Liveness killed the API during local embedding initialization and RollingUpdate briefly doubled model work.
api_startup.green: A startup probe and Recreate strategy prevented premature restarts and duplicate API pods.

embedding_scale.red: Local Nomic initialization did not finish within 14 minutes; the generation endpoint returned 404 for /v1/embeddings.

trusted_route_tls.reason: The Arena ingress chain is not trusted by the external client.

mlflow_server.reason: Arena has an MLflow operator/UI but no shared tracking server service or participant route; tracing was disabled for the degraded application check.

showroom_participant_journey.reason: This was a direct workload-chart certification, not a Launchpad order.

participant_entitlement_proxy.reason: A positive workload-route proxy check requires a persisted Launchpad session.

worker_recovery.observation: rhgnr1 briefly transitioned NotReady during initialization and recovered without pod replacement.

agnosticv_topology_review.decision: Keep the Launchpad-native per-seat adapter and shared cluster services; do not reproduce AgnosticV or AgnosticD.

red_green_matrix.requirement: Complete all participant tabs, shared observability services, entitlement isolation, and reclaim from a Launchpad order.
Run the namespace-scoped AgentOps workload, exercise a real agent call, and reclaim it with zero residue.
Use a shared cached embedding endpoint with successful KB vector ingestion.
Generate and inspect MLflow traces through a participant-accessible shared tracking server.
Validate participant workload routes with a trusted Arena ingress certificate.

test_strategy.TDD: Failing chart and catalog assertions preceded each runtime correction.
test_strategy.EDD: This manifest records live HTTP, application, database, model, capacity, and reclaim observations.
test_strategy.CDD: The generated draft catalog remains equal to its repository-native intake contract.
test_strategy.BDD: A real WebSocket participant-agent exchange reached a done event and persisted checkpoints/audit events.
test_strategy.CBT: Database, API, UI, MinIO, Grafana, DSPA, model access, routes, and cleanup were checked independently.

remaining_blockers: shared cached embedding endpoint and cluster-specific runtime injection
shared MLflow tracking server and participant route
trusted Arena ingress certificate for participant routes
Launchpad-ordered Showroom, entitlement isolation, and full eight-tab journey
